-- Mark Brooker @ Radancy slot 3: find Radancy delegates at slots 1,4,9,10 who are free at slot 3
SELECT 'Mark Brooker - Radancy' as context, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot as currentSlot, s.companyName as sponsor
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName = 'Radancy'
AND m.timeSlot IN (1,4,9,10)
AND m.attendeeId NOT IN (
  SELECT attendeeId FROM meetings WHERE timeSlot = 3
)

UNION ALL

-- Alan MacKinnon @ Poetry slot 10: find Poetry delegates at slots 1,2,5,9,11,12 who are free at slot 10
SELECT 'Alan MacKinnon - Poetry' as context, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot as currentSlot, s.companyName as sponsor
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName = 'Poetry'
AND m.timeSlot IN (1,2,5,9,11,12)
AND m.attendeeId NOT IN (
  SELECT attendeeId FROM meetings WHERE timeSlot = 10
)

ORDER BY context, currentSlot;
